page.overview:
Who is The Funniest Valentine?

Funniest appears as a tall man who wears a suit and a tie with a star on the top of it. His hair appears to be blonde and curly with curls similar to his father and grandfather.

Just like the original Funny Valentine, Funniest Valentine is a patriot. His patriarchy can be seen when he threatened the citizens of Morioh when the town detached itself, and headed towards the United States.

Another trait Funniest Valentine shares with his father, is that he would kill others without hesitation. an example would be that him and his family are willing to commit mass murder, as long as the Saints Corpse does not leave America.

Funniest could is also brave and fearless, even during near-deathly moments, such as when he jumped off of a plane when he lacked a parachute.
